It looks strange but it certainly usable.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== The Monster Saddle can be purchased from [[Kilton]] at the [[Fang and Bone]] for 299 [[Mon]].{{Cite|Ah, a classic. The {{Color BotW|Blue|Monster Saddle}} will cost you {{Color BotW|Red|299 mon}}. Is that OK?|Kilton|BotW}} Kilton made it himself, though it was intended for a more [[Monster]]-like [[Horse]]. Despite their strange appearance, they are still useable for Horses. The Monster Saddle is part of the [[Monster Horse Gear]] set, which is a group of [[Horse Gear]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 161}} [[Link]] can equip his Horses with the Monster Saddle by speaking to specific workers at either [[Highland Stable]], [[Outskirt Stable]], [[South Akkala Stable]], or [[Woodland Stable]].{{Cite|Change to {{Color BotW|Red|Monster Saddle}}?|Canni|BotW}} As is the case with other [[Saddle]]s, they are unable to be utilized by [[Epona]] or the [[Giant Horse]].{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty find horse you have. If you like, I can change out her {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? Actually, this horse is different from any I've ever seen before.
